macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: Nasdaq falls 1.25% as AI concerns weigh on chip stocks
items.summary: The Dow rose 0.10% to 51,232.48, while the S&P 500 fell 0.47% to 7,765.42 and the Nasdaq dropped 1.25% to 27,193.34. Semiconductor stocks weakened after reports questioned OpenAI’s previously signaled revenue run rate, while concerns about large technology-company financing added pressure.[1][10]

items.title: Fed officials signal further rate hikes may be needed
items.summary: St. Louis Fed President James Bullard said additional increases could be necessary over the next six to nine months to bring inflation back to the 2% target. Markets are also pricing renewed concern about a possible rate increase later in the year.[1][2]

items.title: Rising oil prices and bond yields pressure equities
items.summary: Crude prices climbed amid Middle East shipping risks and U.S. production disruptions, reviving inflation and rate-hike concerns. Treasury yields also remained elevated, adding to pressure on growth and technology stocks.[3][10]

items.title: U.S. mortgage rates reach nearly three-year high
items.summary: The average 30-year fixed mortgage rate rose to 7.4% from 7.28% the previous week, marking a seventh consecutive weekly increase and adding to evidence of tighter financial conditions.[1]

items.title: SpaceX agrees to acquire nationwide wireless spectrum portfolio
items.summary: SpaceX announced an agreement to acquire low-frequency spectrum licenses from Grain Management, positioning its Starlink mobile business to compete more directly with U.S. wireless carriers.[1][6]

items.title: PepsiCo cuts profit outlook while announcing further cost reductions
items.summary: PepsiCo shares rose 3.7% after the company announced additional spending cuts and lowered its annual core-profit forecast.[10]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin slips below $84,000 as market momentum weakens
items.summary: Bitcoin traded below $84,000, down about 0.35% over 24 hours, while weakening ETF inflows and declining futures open interest weighed on sentiment.

items.title: Binance Life memecoin rises 12%
items.summary: The BNB Chain-based Binance Life memecoin gained 12% in 24 hours, reaching a reported market capitalization of approximately $540 million.

items.title: UK sanctions five crypto and payments platforms
items.summary: The United Kingdom sanctioned Cryptomus, Heleket, VexPay, TokenSpot and Tsunami Payments for allegedly helping Russia evade financial sanctions.

items.title: EU stablecoin compliance deadline approaches
items.summary: ESMA said MiCA-licensed crypto firms must eliminate remaining exposure to non-compliant stablecoins by January 8, 2027, including stopping related trading, custody, transfers and advice for EU clients.

items.title: Base completes Cobalt upgrade for tokenized assets
items.summary: Base activated its Cobalt upgrade, expanding the B20 token standard with conditional trading and issuer-controlled compliance checks such as identity, investor eligibility and sanctions screening.

items.title: XRP Ledger activates delegated permissions feature
items.summary: The XRP Ledger activated PermissionDelegationV1_1, allowing account owners to authorize other accounts to perform defined actions without sharing the master account key.

items.title: Securitize launches tokenized U.S. stocks
items.summary: Tokenization company Securitize launched tokenized versions of U.S. stocks, expanding its platform’s offerings in blockchain-based representations of traditional securities.

items.title: Bitget reports $388 million security incident
items.summary: Bitget’s chief executive said a security incident caused approximately $388 million in user losses; withdrawals for Bitcoin, Ether and USDT had resumed, with broader withdrawals expected to follow.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Sonic Frontiers Definitive Edition launches on Nintendo Switch 2
items.summary: Sega released Sonic Frontiers Definitive Edition on Nintendo Switch 2 without a prior official announcement or marketing campaign.

items.title: Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced releases on consoles
items.summary: The game became available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, with the PC version scheduled to launch later in the day.

items.title: DOOM: The Dark Ages receives story expansion
items.summary: The paid story expansion Revelations launched on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.

items.title: Crimson Desert announced for Nintendo Switch 2
items.summary: Pearl Abyss confirmed that its open-world action game Crimson Desert is being developed for Nintendo’s latest console.

items.title: Valve enables SteamOS installation on desktop PCs
items.summary: Valve confirmed that SteamOS 3.8 can be installed on broadly compatible standard desktop hardware, expanding the operating system beyond dedicated handheld devices.

items.title: Mortal Shell II open beta reaches 500,000 players
items.summary: Developer Cold Symmetry reported that the recent PC open beta attracted half a million players.

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 film adaptation in development
items.summary: Paramount Pictures is developing a live-action film based on Cyberpunk 2077, with CD Projekt Red attached to produce.

items.title: Microsoft gaming division reportedly cuts 268 jobs
items.summary: Microsoft reportedly dismissed 268 gaming employees amid changes to studio organization and plans for the next mainline Halo project.

items.title: JetSynthesys and MIXI explore gaming and esports partnership
items.summary: India’s JetSynthesys and Japan’s MIXI signed a memorandum to investigate collaboration in gaming, esports, digital entertainment, marketing, and potential investment.

items.title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer released by Guildford studio
items.summary: A Guildford-based team of about 75 developers released a Star Wars racing game that has been in development since 2023.

tech_news.query: What are the most important technology news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major product launches, company news, and significant tech industry developments. Exclude AI-specific news.

items.title: SpaceX acquires low-band spectrum licenses for Starlink Mobile
items.summary: SpaceX has acquired a portfolio of low-band spectrum licenses as it prepares to expand Starlink Mobile into a broader U.S. wireless service. The company said the acquisition will help support its planned satellite-to-phone connectivity offering.

items.title: Apple Mac shipments fall as overall PC market contracts
items.summary: Apple’s Mac shipments reportedly dropped 11% in the third quarter of 2026, although its market share increased from 8.5% to 9.5% as the broader PC market declined 20.1%.

items.title: Google to discontinue Pixel Watch Safety Signal
items.summary: Google is reportedly ending the Safety Signal emergency feature for LTE-connected Pixel Watches by December. The change will remove a service that helped users contact emergency services when ordinary connectivity was unavailable.

items.title: Amazon completes 1,000th satellite for planned internet service
items.summary: Amazon has built its 1,000th satellite as it moves toward launching its satellite internet service by the end of 2026. The milestone advances the company’s effort to compete in the growing space-based broadband market.

items.title: CD Projekt Red’s sci-fi game franchise headed for live-action adaptation
items.summary: Paramount is reportedly developing a live-action film based on CD Projekt Red’s popular science-fiction video game franchise. The project would extend the series into a new entertainment format.
